Scholarship overview

This RMIT PhD scholarship is supported by a Johnson & Johnson WiSTEM2D award and is aimed at research preparation in chemistry, materials or chemical engineering. Applicants should clarify the payment basis of the published award value with the contact before making a funding plan.

Research Areas

  • Chemistry
  • Materials science
  • Chemical engineering

RMIT offers research degrees in science, engineering and other disciplines. Its project scholarships connect doctoral research with defined academic or industry questions and list the support available for each position.
